summary: Reused a proven winning config from a prior session's memory: width over depth (ASPECT_RATIO 64->96, dim 768), sliding window short=long//8 (256) instead of //2, value embeddings on first-3/last-3 layers instead of alternating, TOTAL_BATCH_SIZE halved to 2^18, and WARMDOWN_RATIO kept at 0.5 (shortening it is a dead end). This reproduced a big win: val_bpb 0.978168 vs baseline 0.997359. My own contribution was testing DEPTH=7 within that full stack (same dim=768 after ASPECT_RATIO rounding, one fewer layer), which gave 0.977190 -- a marginal further improvement, right at the run-to-run noise floor (~0.0007), so treat it as a weak tie rather than confirmed win. Next: rerun DEPTH=7 vs 8 a second time each to resolve the tie, and try width slightly beyond 768 (e.g. dim 832) now that window/VE placement are fixed, since the memory noted dim 896 turned over sharply but didn't test the region in between.
